test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: Servise industries rely on a set of processes.
Service industreis relie on a set of processes.
Service industries rely on a set of procceses.
Service industries rely on a set of processes.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence with no spelling error is:** 'Service industries rely on a set of processes.'**
 
• **"Service"** is the correct spelling for the word indicating a system supplying a public need, such as transport, communications, or utilitie
